abort.unsupported_manual_setup: Configuration is only supported via auto-discovery. Check HeishaMon is connected to your MQTT server and sending messages. Also check that Home Assistant is connected to the MQTT server. The integration will then be discovered automatically.

init.title: Access to HeishaMon
init.description: Used for the requests the integration sends directly to the board (reboot button, firmware update). MQTT is not affected.

data_description.api_key: Only needed if a web password is set on HeishaMon. Create the key in the HeishaMon web interface (Settings, System, Access & security). 32 hexadecimal characters; leave empty without login.
data_description.use_https: Talk to HeishaMon over HTTPS (reboot, firmware upload). Requires HTTPS to be enabled on HeishaMon (large board only). There is no fallback to HTTP.
data_description.cert_fingerprint: Only used with HTTPS. Copy the SHA-256 fingerprint shown on the access page of HeishaMon (64 hexadecimal characters, colons and spaces are allowed); this is needed for the self-signed certificate of HeishaMon. Leave empty only if you uploaded a certificate that is issued by a certificate authority Home Assistant trusts and is valid for the IP address of the board: it is then verified like any web site.

error.invalid_api_key: The API key must be empty or consist of exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_cert_fingerprint: The certificate fingerprint must be empty or a SHA-256 fingerprint of exactly 64 hexadecimal characters (colons and spaces are allowed).

reboot_unauthorized.message: HeishaMon rejected the request because a web login is active. Enter the API key of HeishaMon (created on its access page) in the options of the integration.

firmware_upload_connection_failed.message: Could not upload firmware version {version} to HeishaMon at {host}: {error}. The network or a restart of the board may have interrupted the upload. If a password is set on HeishaMon, a missing or wrong API key has the same effect: check the API key in the options of the integration.

certificate_fingerprint_mismatch.message: The certificate of HeishaMon at {host} does not match the fingerprint in the options of the integration. The certificate has probably changed (regenerated or uploaded on HeishaMon). Copy the new SHA-256 fingerprint from the access page of HeishaMon into the options of the integration.

certificate_verification_failed.message: The certificate of HeishaMon at {host} could not be verified against the certificate authorities Home Assistant trusts. Enter the SHA-256 fingerprint shown on the access page of HeishaMon in the options of the integration, or upload a trusted certificate that is valid for this address to HeishaMon.
